item.description: Macworld Following the release of iOS 16.2 on Friday, December 12, the first beta release of iOS 26.3 was made available to developers a few days later, on December 15. item.title: macOS 26 Tahoe Guide: New features in the latest macOS 26.3 update
item.description: Macworld Like its counterparts on the other Apple devices, in September 2026 macOS got a brand new look along with a new name. item.title: Apple just can’t get Siri working right
item.description: Macworld Apple just can’t seem to get its new Siri off the ground. A new report from Mark Gurman at Bloomberg says that testing of the big Siri overhaul due in iOS 26.4 (soon to enter beta, with a release planned for March) will instead be spread out over the rest of the year. At this point, it’s hard to have confidence that important planned features won’t be delayed further.
